title: Existence of normalized derived tensor-Hom maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, with the derived category of its modules and recorded derived tensor. There exists a family of functions $t_{K,L,M}:\operatorname{Hom}(K,R\mathcal Hom(L,M))\to\operatorname{Hom}(K\otimes^L L,M)$ satisfying exactly the naturality and componentwise representative normalization of [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-model]. No bijectivity is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08DJ (lemma-internal-hom); component calculation in sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 0A90

proof.text: Obtain the descended family and its representative equation and isomorphism transport from lem-pc-tensor-hom-uncurry-descent. Apply lem-pc-tensor-hom-uncurry-descent-naturality for arbitrary-morphism naturality. For each representative, take the explicitly constructed schemeTensorHomUncurry; its summand identity supplies the component clause and the descent equation supplies the localization clause. Combine the two clauses of IsCanonicalDerivedTensorHomMap.
